name: use-organizations
title: useOrganizations, useMembers, useInvitations
description: useOrganizations, useMembers and useInvitations: the organizations block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the organizations block (`npx better-supabase add organizations`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/organizations.
